grid_region: Netherlands (assumed from VU Amsterdam lab context)
grid_factor_basis: 2026 Dutch location-based gridmix: 244 gCO2e/kWh production and fuel chain plus 16 gCO2e/kWh electricity infrastructure; annual reporting factor, not measured October 2026 intensity
embodied_basis: Whole-workstation proxy: Dell Precision 7960 Tower PCF, March 2023: 2971 kgCO2e times (22.9% manufacturing + 2.5% transport + 0.6% end of life). Not an LCA of glg2 or its actual two GPUs.
notes: Other hardware, PSU efficiency, PUE, lifespan and exclusive reservation are explicit modeling assumptions. No idle subtraction. Calibration power is estimated from the corresponding evaluation benchmark and fixed-model strategy. Initial setup uses the recorded creation-to-first-process elapsed time less the first cooldown. Unknown later setup, fitting, downloads, tests and analysis time are excluded and disclosed, not treated as measured zero.
